value.rationale: A natural baseline-invariant pairwise dispersion seminorm yields a complete, nontrivial stability classification of classical cyclic morphological opening: nonexpansive only at \(n\le3\), first amplification at \(n=4\), first strict dominance of triplication at \(n=6\), and exact asymptotic ceiling \(3\). The distinct finite-size thresholds in the Gini and centered-Hilbert metrics and the difference from adjacent-edge TV show a substantive metric-dependent phenomenon rather than renaming a known calculation.
